s.n: Tour rider tropical fruit with chilli salt
s.how: Peel and slice 2 mangoes, half a pineapple, a quarter watermelon and half a papaya into long wedges. Chill on a big platter for 30 minutes. Grind 1 tbsp sea salt flakes with 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp caster sugar and the zest of 2 limes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and sprinkle with the chilli salt. Serve with extra lime wedges.

Soak 500g chicken tenderloins in 200ml buttermilk with salt for 30 minutes. Toss in 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Shallow fry at 180C for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp sriracha. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with 1 tbsp vinegar. Fill 8 toasted brioche slider buns with chicken, slaw, pickles and the mayo.

m.n: Style Boyz fish tacos with mango salsa
m.note: getting the Style Boyz back together
m.how: Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, the zest of 1 lime and 1 tbsp oil. Grill 3 minutes a side and flake. Dice 1 mango, half a red onion and 1 red chilli and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blend 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, then add 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste and 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut 16 rounds with a 8cm cutter. Bake at 170C for 12 minutes and cool. Mix 300g icing sugar with 3 tbsp water and a drop of black colouring to make grey. Flood each cookie, let it set, then pipe thin circles for grooves and a small coloured label in the centre.

d.how: Thinly slice 1 Lebanese cucumber. In a jug, muddle 8 cucumber slices with a handful of mint leaves, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Add 160ml gin and stir. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and the rest of the cucumber slices. Strain the gin mix into the glasses and top each with 120ml sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.
